acceptance: Current split ops-edit notebook/commands/shared/seed suites must run green; a future child adds the active-notebook dangling regression to the live split test owner while preserving non-active, default, and cascade invariants.
acceptance_cmd: cd backend && uv run pytest -q tests/test_ops_edit_notebook.py tests/test_ops_edit_notebook_commands_unit.py tests/test_ops_edit_shared_unit.py tests/test_ops_edit_seed.py
brief: 用工具刪掉一本單字本後,帳號的「新字歸哪本」會指向不存在的本,而檢查說一切正常。
contract_evidence: Official preflight --probe-acceptance of the stale command returned rc5 with no tests ran; direct stale command reproduced rc5. The exact refreshed split suite command ran 86 passed in 149.71s. No child was opened and no source was changed.
detail:
`ops_edit` 的 `notebook-delete`(`backend/src/kg/ops_edit_notebook_commands.py:103-119`)刪掉一本 notebook 後,`users.json` 的 `config.vocab_ui.active_notebook_id` 若正指向那本,會留下懸空指標而 verify 報綠。後果是該帳號的「新選詞歸哪本」指向不存在的本;`backend/src/kg/api_models/notebook.py:67` 只把 "default" 當缺省值,不做存在性回退。

IMP-0024 已在 `seed --replace` 的 verify 加了同族偵測(`dangling_config`,見 `_seed_replace_verdict`),可直接沿用同一個形狀:讀 users.json 的 active_notebook_id,不在現存 notebook id 集合且非 "default" 就進 verify 的紅。`notebook-delete` 這條是**既有缺口、非 IMP-0024 引入**,故當時未一併修。

要決定的取捨:是 verify 報紅要 operator 自己跑 `user-config-set --active-notebook`,還是 apply 時就自動 reset 成 "default"。後者會動到 identity 檔,與現行「notebook 操作不碰 users.json」的邊界有張力,建議先做前者。同一形狀也該檢查 `notebook-delete --cascade` 與 world-restore 路徑。
plan: 在現行 cmd_notebook_delete.verify_fn 補讀 users.json 的 config.vocab_ui.active_notebook_id，與 live notebook IDs 比對；沿用或抽出現有 _dangling_active_notebook 形狀，回報結構化 dangling_config 並使 verified.ok=false；plain 與 --cascade 共用，不自動 reset。
resolution: Contract-blocked 2026-08-12: the original acceptance pointed at backend/tests/test_ops_edit.py, a three-line shim with no tests, so pytest returned rc5 no tests ran. The live test ownership is split across test_ops_edit_notebook.py, test_ops_edit_notebook_commands_unit.py, test_ops_edit_shared_unit.py, and test_ops_edit_seed.py; acceptance and fix_site now point to that exact existing suite. Keep blocked until this refreshed contract is groomed and a focused active-notebook RED regression is established.
scope: 後端一支 ops 子指令的 verify 加一道檢查,配一支測試。
